title: Job orders
subtitle: One card per order, with how far along it is against the quantity ordered. Filter by stage, or search by order number and product; open a card for pricing, production and the lifecycle.
newSubtitle: Pick an existing product or define a new one inline. Prices are computed from the product specification and pricing inputs, recomputed on every save.
editSubtitle: Pricing is computed from the product specification and pricing inputs, recomputed on every save.
noPricingPermission: You do not have permission to edit this order's pricing.

grid.archiveBody: Order {numero} will be hidden from the default list. Nothing is deleted — its production and invoicing history stays intact.
grid.restoreBody: Order {numero} will appear in the list again.

transitions.discardInvoiceBody: The draft is deleted and the order returns to invoicing. Nothing has been numbered yet, so nothing is lost but the edits.
transitions.discardShipmentBody: The draft shipment is deleted and the order returns to invoiced; its invoice is free to be paired with a new shipment.
transitions.mentionBody: A draft invoice is created and the order moves to invoiced. Choose the certification mention its designation carries, if any — it can still be changed on the draft.

production.title: Production entries
production.empty: Nothing recorded against this order yet.

inks.title: Ink used
inks.empty: No ink drawn for this order yet.
inks.totalDrawn: Total drawn: {total} (summed across units as recorded).
inks.deleteBody: {quantity} {unit} of {code} goes back on the shelf. The line is removed, not archived.
inks.noColourInStock: No colour has ink in stock

form.kindQuoteHint: A quote is priced like an order but stays out of production: no paper can be reserved and it cannot be started. Accept it from its page to turn it into an order — it keeps its number.
form.reuseSpecHint: If a product with this exact specification already exists for this client (or is shared), it is reused rather than duplicated.
form.legacyGlueHint: This order carries a legacy glue cost of {value} / unit, recorded by the previous system. It applies while all three glue lines above are blank; entering any of them replaces it.
form.inksEmpty: No inks recorded for this order.
form.inksHint: Saved as a set: the list below replaces whatever the order had. A row with no name and no price is dropped.
form.specIncomplete: This product's width, length or grammage is not set — enter it on the product's page to price this order.
form.pickProductForFigures: Pick a product to see live figures.
form.fillSpecForFigures: Fill in the type, width, length and grammage above to see live figures.
form.pickProductOrNew: Pick a product, or switch to defining a new one
form.marginWarning: The profit margin ({profit}%) does not exceed the loss margin ({loss}%), so this order sells at or below cost.
form.needPaperPriceError: Enter a paper price above zero

detail.draftInvoiceHint: Not yet numbered — open it to edit the lines and issue it.
detail.draftShipmentHint: Not yet numbered — open it to set the packing list and ship it.
detail.legacyPricingReprice: Saving this order will price it with the current engine.

paper.title: Paper
paper.empty: No paper reserved for this order yet.
paper.openWarning: {count, plural, one {# reservation is still open} other {# reservations are still open}} on an order past production — consume or cancel them.
paper.legacyNote: {count, plural, one {# allocation was} other {# allocations were}} recorded by weight only and are not in the metre totals.
paper.consumeBody: {metres} m of {reel} are reserved. Enter what the run actually used; the rest goes back to free stock.
paper.cancelBody: {metres} m of {reel} go back to free stock.
paper.cancelLegacyBody: This allocation was recorded by weight; the reel is not adjusted.

picker.title: Find reels
picker.subtitle: Reels of the product's grammage at or above the production width. Exact fits first; a wider reel is slit into bands first.
picker.empty: No reel of this grammage is wide enough. Check the stock, or the product's paper.
picker.reserveHint: {free} m of {reel} are free. The reserved length stays on this reel until it is consumed.
picker.cutReserveHint: {free} m of {reel} are free. A new reel of exactly this length is cut off and reserved whole.
